Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Nothing will stop ruthless predators on their way to their prey.Their survival depends on large herds of animals that have been coming to the same place year after year for millennia to quench their thirst.Lions, leopards and hyenas know perfectly well that they will not survive if they do not engage in a fierce fight to the death.The creators of the series will show this fight from a different perspective.They will present the brutal world of animals from both the predator and the prey perspective.Viewers will witness a bloody struggle for power against the background of beautiful African landscapes.They will learn the motives behind every move of the fighters and see that it is a world where no one stays on top forever, and only the strongest survive.

programme.title: America The Beautiful: Wild Frontier
programme.desc: An episode devoted to the three great rivers of North America - the Mississippi, Missouri and Ohio.Their combination with other local rivers creates a huge mass of water that divides the United States in two.Due to harsh winters, animals living in riverine areas had to learn how to cope with these difficult conditions.Among them there are otters hunting among ice floes, bald eagles - the symbol of the USA - and stately and predatory lynxes.Thousands of seasonally migrating snow geese also fly to the river.The arrival of winter forces many animal species to make numerous preparations.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club 5
programme.desc: Another installment of a fascinating series showing the fiercest clashes in the animal world.We will see extraordinary weapons and incredible tactics used by participants in the fierce fight for survival.The program presents recordings of the most powerful predators, such as lions, crocodiles and sharks, and tiny but surprisingly tough creatures, such as grasshoppers and brave insects.From the plains of Africa to the snowy wastes of North America, these are battlefields for territory, dominance and females.Thanks to elements of computer graphics, scenes presented in slow motion, close-ups and replays of key moments, viewers will not miss any detail.

programme.title: Dolphins Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: British filmmaker Bertie Gregory brings nature's wonders to life with groundbreaking cinematography in some of Earth's most extreme environments.Recently, for example, National Geographic viewers could observe the inhabitants of the frosty south in the film "The Secret Life of Penguins".The heroes of the latest documentary are mammals famous for their intelligence.Equipped with drones, state-of-the-art cameras and underwater technologies, creators can capture their world from a previously unavailable perspective.A haven for marine mammals, the Azores are an archipelago of volcanic islands located in the central part of the Atlantic Ocean.They are considered one of the best places for observing whales and dolphins.Bertie Gregory reaches the coast of Portugal, where the hunting season is in progress.Thousands of predators hunt together for large schools of fish that form balls.The team, struggling with storms, tries to film this rare spectacle of nature.It also follows pods of dolphins that perform acrobatics by jumping out of the water.During his journey, Bertie also discovers the dark history of marine exploitation in the region.He has the opportunity to see the consequences of the whaling ban in the 1980s.
